notes.problem: Primitive boom, UI-like board in an off-deck palette, empty black top.
notes.fix: A physical board in the deck's steel and green with one gold strip, the camera on one real mount, tile raised to the dek, the camera's cast across the board.

notes.problem: Untextured primitives on a boom with two disconnected plates, a flat pastel board, a black blob at its corner.
notes.fix: Reuse the chassis camera on one plate and one jointed arm; marker lanes and case blocks in the deck's colours with a specular streak; soft casts from frame and tray.

notes.problem: Boom links two plates that float apart, the board is flat rectangles, the tile ends in a hard edge into a black band under the dek.
notes.fix: One wall plate and a two piece arm, raised magnetic case cards with casts and a tray, tile extended up behind the dek.

notes.problem: The white tape reads as faint grey wedges.
notes.fix: A bright white stripe of real height with its own cast; a few degrees off plan.

notes.problem: A mid grey chart grid; the white tape invisible at 432 px.
notes.fix: A raised band at L* 85 or more with its own cast; lids in a pool and the empty bays to black.

notes.problem: The white tape is a grey strip, the 8.3 low end invisible at 432 px.
notes.fix: A bright raised white stripe three times wider; rake the key lower so lids cast long.

notes.problem: A pale mid tone page, the one light frame.
notes.fix: Crop the page into dark steel on three sides, rake the key low, the lower third in shadow.

notes.problem: A beige page over 60 percent of the frame at uniform mid tone.
notes.fix: Angle and bleed the page, light only its upper half and the clip.

notes.problem: A pale mid grey page with DOM quotes, relief mostly the clip.
notes.fix: Page about 40 percent of the frame, a curled lower corner casting, only its upper half lit.

notes.problem: Cameras as dark stubs, a flat plan.
notes.fix: Pale lit housings with long casts; taller walls.

notes.problem: A CAD plan, cameras as dark stubs.
notes.fix: A 30 to 40 degree three quarter view; pale lit camera housings.

notes.problem: The four cameras read as dark stubs.
notes.fix: Lit pale housings at twice the scale with faint view wedges.

notes.problem: A hard black back-wall base slab behind the wall on 3 and 4.
notes.fix: Extend the floor and pool to the far wall or lower the wall base below the horizon.

notes.problem: An evenly lit wall, a tan crown, no bleed.
notes.fix: A hard rake from high left with a specular edge on the gold rows; widen so the wall bleeds; mirror on 3.

notes.problem: The wall camera crowds the dek's third line.
notes.fix: Drop it about 120 px and move it right.

rounds_source: this module's own log of cards it has scored
work_order: no judge found a hard fail, and the median 7.25 is under this round's rung of 7.7. KEEP EDITING: fix the judges' named defects, re-render and re-score. At the round cap the finished deck ships whatever it scored. Start with the frames the judges charge the art for, in this order, slides 7, 5, 8, 2, 3, 4, 9 (`artwork_weakest_frames`), one concrete change each
